title: TAVI API — record lock rule on Leads (Round2RecordsTest.recordLockEnforced, 27 Oct 2026)
lines: POST /modules/{leads}/record-locks {name, condition: "zz not a condition !!"}  -> 201 (nonsense condition accepted)
POST /modules/{leads}/record-locks {name, condition: "first_name starts_with QA W2 R2 LK"}  -> 201 (status active)
create lead "QA W2 R2 LK …" (matches the rule)  -> 201
CRM Admin A: PATCH company = "QA locked edit"  -> 200
read back: company = "QA locked edit"  -> the matching record was edited although it is locked
Structured conditions ({pattern, conditions}) are refused 400; only free text is accepted. Settings tab "Record Locking Configuration" says In Development.
